# class_id: # mechanism: a MACHINE that makes the class unrepresentable. Not a rule, not a
#   warning. Two legal placeholders and nothing between them:
#     -               no mechanism yet. Legal only below the escalation threshold.
#     unmechanizable  we looked; there is no machine. Legal, counted, displayed.
# search_key: a command that ENUMERATES other sites. A class without one cannot
#   be swept, so its propagation failures are invisible and it stays local.

mechanism: every gate emits (verdict, manifest); the manifest is the enumeration of what it inspected, diffed against an independently derived one
a gate's printed title is derived from its manifest rather than written beside it
search_key: for each gate, compare its printed title to the predicate it evaluates

mechanism: machine-dependent quantities are stripped from any artifact that is compared or claimed
